baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural noun النُّجُومُ is the subject of the passive perfect طُمِسَتْ in the فَإِذَا event construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Celestial bodies whose ordinary image is rising and visible undergo a loss of light; the passive form foregrounds the completed change rather than its agent.

activation_trace.role: The rising star supplies the literal celestial collective whose visibility defines the initial state.
Loss of stellar light supplies the direct change imposed on that collective.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely announces that something happens to the stars.
changed_reading.after: At the announced threshold, the stars cease to function as visible lights.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: النُّجُومُ can be profiled as projecting markers, while طُمِسَتْ can erase a trace, road, or distinguishable route.
baseline_models.mechanism: The affected stars form a readable coordinate system; wiping their traces removes not only brightness but the means of locating and orienting oneself.

activation_trace.role: The visible projecting marker turns the stars into reference points rather than light sources alone.
Erasing a trace or road makes the event the deletion of a readable map.
A place left without path or trace supplies the resulting condition of disorientation.

changed_reading.after: The sky's visible reference points are wiped away, leaving no inherited route or coordinate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical field of النجم includes both appearing and the clearing that reveals stars, whereas طمس removes their light.
baseline_models.mechanism: Normal clearing makes stars emerge into view; this event reverses that relation, so even an unobstructed sky can no longer disclose them.

activation_trace.role: Clearing cloud or rain normally reveals the stars and supplies the expected disclosure process.
Loss of the stars' own light defeats disclosure even after an obstruction clears.

changed_reading.before: Obscurity results from something covering the stars.
changed_reading.after: The stars themselves lose the capacity to emerge into visibility: an anti-clearing rather than ordinary concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder and warning point ahead to an appointed promise; once that promise falls into fixed occurrence, the celestial markers that pointed toward it are erased because indication has yielded to presence.

activation_trace.role: The projecting marker makes the stars a visible system of advance indication.
Erasure of a trace gives that indicative system a terminal boundary.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the preceding sign-bearing phase.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the awaited terminus.
Falling and becoming fixed converts the promised future into realized presence.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from cast reminder and warning in 77:5-6 to the assertion that the promised event is واقع in 77:7, immediately followed by فَإِذَا in 77:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, appointed promise, fixed occurrence, and then marker-erasure; I infer that signs are retired when their referent arrives. A live alternative is that these are simply consecutive announcements of physical catastrophe.

changed_reading.before: A useful celestial map is abruptly destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The advance-sign system reaches its expiry when the promised reality becomes present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial markers are erased, the upper enclosure is split, terrestrial masses are uprooted, and then a new decisive boundary is imposed. The old above-below coordinate system is dismantled before judicial separation replaces it.

activation_trace.role: Visible projecting markers supply the celestial coordinates removed first.
A surface without trace or route supplies the unusable topology left by their removal.
Opening a fissure removes the sky's continuity as an upper boundary.
A gathered, elevated solid supplies the terrestrial landmark and anchor.
Uprooting and removal deletes that solid landmark from its place.
Making a boundary visible supplies the new, adjudicative distinction after physical boundaries fail.

structural_cues: 77:8-11 forms a parallel sequence of إذا clauses with passive perfect verbs, followed by the answer لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ in 77:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erased markers, an opened sky, uprooted mountains, and a day of separation; I infer a replacement of physical coordinates by judicial distinction. Alternatively, each image may independently intensify universal collapse without forming one spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts one item in a list of damaged cosmic objects.
changed_reading.after: It initiates a staged reset of the world's coordinate system so that a different kind of separation can govern.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stars and lunar stations provide recurring celestial time marks. Their erasure coincides with messengers being assigned a time, a deferred term reaching its day, and adjudication beginning: ordinary calendrical deferral is decommissioned at its deadline.

activation_trace.role: Stars and lunar stations supply the recurring celestial marks by which ordinary time is tracked.
Erasure removes those marks once their terminal date is reached.
Fixing something by a time or limit supplies explicit temporal assignment.
A bounded span of time supplies the named interval into which the event resolves.
A prescribed temporal endpoint supplies the close of deferment.
A judgment separating true from false supplies what begins when the deadline closes.

structural_cues: The questions and answers in 77:11-14 densely repeat time, day, deferment, and separation immediately after the cosmic إذا sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies celestial bodies, erased marks, explicit timing, deferment, and a judgment day; I infer that the stars also function as the clock of the deferred order. The alternative is literal extinction with no calendrical role.

changed_reading.before: The stars lose light during an otherwise continuing sequence of time.
changed_reading.after: The celestial clock is struck from service because deferred time has reached its adjudicative endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation block moves from formed creation through emplacement, stability, measure, containment, and anchoring. The focus event runs that vector backward: stellar form is obliterated as the placed and measured cosmos is de-formed and unseated.

activation_trace.role: Things risen into visible form supply the configured objects subjected to reversal.
Obliterating or transforming form supplies the reverse operation on the configured cosmos.
Complete, proportioned formation supplies the constructive vector later reversed.
Rendering a thing into a state supplies deliberate configuration.
Fixity and settlement supply stable placement.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies bounded proportion.
Gathering and holding in a receptacle supplies terrestrial containment.
Firm anchoring supplies the culmination of the created order's stability.

structural_cues: The 77:20-27 unit progresses from lowly fluid to secure lodging, known measure, an encompassing earth, and anchored heights; it follows the earlier sequence that erases and uproots cosmic structures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a constructive sequence of form, placement, measure, containment, and anchoring alongside earlier effacement; I supply the reverse arrow from creation to de-creation. The live alternative is that the creation block proves power without specifying a reversed process.

changed_reading.before: A star's luminosity is switched off.
changed_reading.after: The formed and emplaced stellar order begins to be unmade, reversing the surah's later grammar of measured creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distant orienting lights are extinguished; later, a non-sheltering shadow opens onto flame that actively throws large sparks. Darkness is therefore not empty but a transfer from stable lights one reads to hostile lights that move toward the observer.

activation_trace.role: Rising stars supply distant, stable points of light.
Loss of light removes those stable points from the visual field.
Shade as covering establishes the promised shelter that the next verse explicitly denies.
The tongue and flare of fire supplies the aggressive replacement light.
Sending a projectile gives the new light an incoming direction.
Flying sparks supply mobile points of fire that replace the erased stellar points.

structural_cues: 77:29-33 commands movement into a three-branched shadow, negates its shade, and then fills the scene with thrown sparks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinguished stars, failed shade, flame, projectile motion, and sparks; I infer a visual-regime replacement from orienting lights to assaultive lights. Alternatively, the two light scenes may contrast only by juxtaposition, without causal transfer.

changed_reading.before: Stellar extinction leaves a neutral darkness.
changed_reading.after: Readable lights disappear and are replaced by thrown, hostile counterlights from which the offered shadow cannot protect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stars construed as visible signs lose their trace, while the judgment scene removes speech and the surah closes by asking what later discourse could produce trust. Celestial indication and verbal defense both reach a terminal point before direct encounter.

activation_trace.role: The visible marker supplies a nonverbal sign that can be read.
Erasure of writing, trace, or road removes that sign's readable surface.
Articulated speech supplies the human representational channel that is explicitly unavailable that day.
Discourse continually renewed as report supplies the final question about any subsequent message.
Trusting assent supplies the response that no later discourse is expected to elicit.

structural_cues: The surah opens with the casting of reminder, later declares a day of no speech, and ends by denying the efficacy of any discourse after this one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible markers, erased traces, unavailable speech, final discourse, and failed assent; I infer a shared closure of mediated sign systems before direct judgment. The alternative is that cosmic visibility and courtroom speech are independent losses.

changed_reading.before: Only a physical source of light is removed.
changed_reading.after: A readable celestial medium is withdrawn as the entire interval for signs, replies, and delayed assent closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus removes high projecting marks from view; elsewhere height is named in the mountains, while the deniers refuse the commanded lowering of the head. Cosmic elevation yields, but human posture resists the corresponding descent.

activation_trace.role: A visible projection supplies the stars as elevated marks.
Alteration and obliteration of form removes the projecting profile rather than merely dimming it.
Mountain height projecting into the sky makes vertical elevation an explicit surah-wide feature.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the human vertical response that is commanded and refused.

structural_cues: Raised cosmic forms are erased or uprooted early in the surah, whereas 77:48 repeats the command to bow and the refusal to do so.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erased high markers, explicitly towering mountains, and refused bodily lowering; I infer an ethical contrast between cosmic yielding and human resistance. The live alternative is that erasure has no posture-like force and the parallel is only visual.

changed_reading.before: The stars are passive casualties of cosmic collapse.
changed_reading.after: Their lost elevation participates in a cosmic lowering that exposes the anomaly of humans who still refuse to bow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because immediate syntax and the following sky verse strongly favor celestial stars. It remains anchored in the attested stemless-plant branch of نجم and the bare, pathless-ground branch of طمس, which the earth-life-watering block reactivates; downstream prose should present it only as an ecological lexical echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes the plant branch of النُّجُومُ with the no-growth, no-trace branch of طُمِسَتْ.

activation_trace.role: Stemless ground plants supply a form-distant but exact lexical image for النجوم.
Bare ground without vegetation, path, or trace supplies the ecological result of effacement.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the substrate from which the small plants would emerge.
Earth brought to life by rain and vegetation makes plant emergence part of the surah's material field.
Providing irrigation supplies the enabling water whose withdrawal is the inferred ecological reverse.

changed_reading.before: Only the heavenly stars are effaced.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, even the earth's low shoots are imagined erased into fresh, trackless ground.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because طمس here overwhelmingly evokes effacement, not estimation. It remains anchored in its attested reckoning branch, the star-reading and planning branch of نجم, and the surah's explicit measure and failed scheme; downstream prose should mark it as wordplay in which instruments of calculation are themselves brought under final calculation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: النُّجُومُ can evoke reading the stars and planning, while طُمِسَتْ has an estimation or reckoning branch.

activation_trace.role: Looking into stars and thinking through a plan supplies the human practice of celestial calculation.
Estimation or reckoning supplies a rare secondary resonance inside the passive event.
Ordering an affair through estimation and regard supplies the surah's explicit governing calculation.
Scheme and stratagem supply a rival human calculation that the challenge renders ineffective.

changed_reading.before: The celestial objects used for reckoning are simply erased.
changed_reading.after: In a branch-level pun, star-reading and human planning are themselves subjected to the terminal measure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because عيون in 77:41 denotes springs in its immediate reward scene, not literal eyes. It remains branch-backed through the eye/source polysemy and is anchored to طمس as loss of light and sight; downstream prose should qualify it as a contrastive echo in which unprotected celestial visibility collapses while protected sources of seeing and water remain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The loss-of-light-and-sight branch of طُمِسَتْ permits the stellar event to be heard as a crisis of vision.

activation_trace.role: The visible star supplies the remote light on which ordinary seeing depends.
Loss of both light and sight explicitly couples celestial extinction to failed vision.
Protection from harm restricts the later scene to a sheltered cohort.
Covering shade supplies a protected visual environment rather than exposed cosmic darkness.
The seeing eye supplies the live secondary resonance of عيون.
The flowing water source supplies the immediate sense while preserving the eye/source coupling.

changed_reading.before: The stellar blackout is an undifferentiated loss of visibility.
changed_reading.after: As a contained eye/spring echo, exposed sky-borne visibility fails while sight and source are re-sited within protection.

strongest_changes: The erased stars became an expired system of advance signs once the promised event is present.
The parallel sky, mountain, and separation sequence turned stellar erasure into the first operation of a spatial and judicial reset.
Explicit timing and deferment made the stars a celestial clock decommissioned at the deadline.
The measured-creation block supported a reverse process of de-forming and unseating the configured cosmos.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 77:8 function simultaneously as extinction, erased orientation, closure of sign and time regimes, inverse creation, and a vertical contrast with refused bowing, while preserving branch-backed ecological and calculative echoes without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The marker-expiry, calendrical, and inverse-creation arrows are coherent but reader-supplied; the packet does not state those causal relations directly.
The passive agent and the exact physical mode of طمس remain unspecified.
The plant, reckoning, and eye/spring outliers are lexically anchored but strongly form-distant from the immediate celestial syntax.
